description: Use when a web page should show the live, rotatable 3D viewer of a CS2 item. Returns cs2embed.js loader code (default), a raw iframe or a React component, from a Steam inspect link or a catalog id. Tell the user to add the page origin under Allowed origins in the dashboard. For a flat picture use render_still. Example: {"id":"ak47_cu_ak47_cobra_gen","wear":0.24,"seed":661,"scene":"plate_dust2_video","controls":"poses","origin":"https://shop.example"}

autorotate.description: Spin until the visitor first touches the frame.

bg.description: Background behind the item. transparent lets the page show through.

offsetX.description: X of the hanging point in Source units, -64 to 64. Send all three offsets or none.

offsetY.description: Y of the hanging point in Source units, -64 to 64. Send all three offsets or none.

offsetZ.description: Z of the hanging point in Source units, -64 to 64. Send all three offsets or none.

stickerId.description: Sticker in a Sticker Slab. defIndex 37 only.

controls.description: What a visitor can do. Default basic. full adds first person.

inspect.description: Steam inspect link with the item as hex (copied from inside CS2, or a gen link), or the hex alone.

name.description: Name tag, up to 20 printable characters. Only with id.

origin.description: Origin of the page that will host the frame, such as https://shop.example or http://localhost:3000.

scene.description: Map backdrop: plate_train_video, plate_ancient_video, plate_office_video, plate_dust2_video, plate_test_valley_waterfall (Splinter), plate_mocha_video, plate_boulder_video, plate_creek_video or plate_zion_video. bg wins if both are sent.

seed.description: Pattern seed, 0 to 1000. Only with id.

stattrak.description: Kill counter. Any value makes the item StatTrak, 0 included. Only with id.

stickers.description: Up to 5 stickers. Only with id.

offsetX.description: Move from the slot default, -1 to 1.

offsetY.description: Move from the slot default, -1 to 1.

slot.description: Sticker position, 0 to 7. A slot may repeat.

theme.description: Styles the name plate, wordmark and buttons.

variant.description: script: the cs2embed.js loader (default). iframe: a raw iframe. react: a React component.

name: embed_snippet
title: Build a CS2 3D viewer embed
